summary: Ga2O3 thin films were deposited via plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) using trimethylgallium and oxygen plasma. A wide ALD temperature window from 100 to 400 /C14 C was observed with a constant deposition rate of 0.53 A˚ /cycle. The films were amorphous as-deposited and crystallized to polycrystalline b-Ga2O3 upon annealing at 900 /C14 C under N2 atmosphere. The study aimed to investigate the growth parameters and properties of Ga2O3 films for potential applications.
